verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox environment (square-docs-21, square-docs-40, square-docs-16) explicitly separate from production, with API Explorer, GraphQL Explorer, and the MCP server all supporting Sandbox-mode testing (SANDBOX=true env var, square-supp-mcp-tools; square-supp-mcp-remote notes local MCP can target a seller's Sandbox). This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to test without touching production data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that sandbox behavior fully mirrors production edge cases, and no explicit demonstration of an agent actually running an end-to-end test session against Sandbox via MCP.
